items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: And Mr. Jones and the circus would so acclaim her.

ctx.x: She rode the horse too, or no?

Oh, yes. She rode the horse bareback, I think, with just the flannel over to keep her dress clean, but she was always beautifully gowned. And these pigeons made a perfect pitch out of her, because she was a beautiful woman in those days. And Mr. Jones and the circus would so acclaim her. And with these pigeons, the white pigeons, you know, with a little streak in the wings, lighting on her shoulder, she made a picture, a picture that you couldn't resist looking at. And these were flashing on the billboards, see?…
